messages:
Renee: Hey runtime team — marketing needs a compact, reproducible spot-check to support one sentence latency claim for the launch post. Not a full benchmark; a tight, explainable snapshot that we can cite.

Renee: Ask: run the following variants: redwood/santa-13b (stable), redwood/santa-13b-int8, redwood/santa-13b-int4. 40 measured samples per variant, 8 warmup prefixes, RNG seed=2026. Measure server-side end-to-end latency and record median/p95/p99. Include 8 raw prompt->response pairs per variant and mark cache hits.

Diego: Quick check: hosted catalog OK? Also confirm max_tokens and prompt template.

Renee: Use hosted. Prompt: "Summarize in two lines: <article_text>". max_tokens=150 for the main run. Also run a short-input follow-up: max_tokens=50 with 20 samples/variant.

Maya: We'll do a smoke-quality check on 8 samples/variant and flag any generation truncations. Where to drop artifacts?

Renee: gs://redwood-marketing/mini-spot-5060012345/ or /shared/marketing/mini-spot-5060012345.zip. Put a CSV with percentiles and a small README with run notes (seed, warmup, cache flags).

bench-bot: Job queued: job_id=mini-spot-5060012345, ETA ~25m.

Diego: Warmup done. Noting one transient node preempted during warmup; will retry and ignore warmup retries in measured set, will annotate if it affected results.

Diego: Main run finished - stable median=142ms, p95=310ms, p99=455ms. cache_hit rate ~80%. Uploading raws now.

Renee: 142ms is above our 120ms headline. Run the short-input batch and let us know. If short-input median <120ms we can qualify the claim as "on short inputs".

Diego: Short-input results: stable median=102ms, p95=195ms, p99=340ms. int8=88ms median, int4=81ms. A couple int4 long runs had mild truncation; short-input outputs look fine. Artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-marketing/mini-spot-5060012345/. CSV and raw JSONs included.

Maya: I checked content — quality consistent across variants for short inputs. We'll draft a 1-paragraph caveated blurb for the launch doc.

Renee: Perfect. Please include the GCS link in the launch doc and note: seed=2026, sample counts, warmup=8, cache_hit annotation, and that long-context medians are higher. Thanks!
